newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Rowan Cos FY97 estimate upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Rowan Cos FY97 estimate upped.

text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc Thursday raised its estimate for Rowan Cos Inc's fiscal 1997 earnings to $1.75 per share from $1.55.

-- Hanifen cited the company's recently signed letter of intent with Mobil Corp to become one of three drilling contractors scheduled to compete for two long-term contracts. Additionally, dayrates for oil rig services in the North Sea are picking up, Hanifen said.
-- Hanifen added that Rowan should also beat its $0.23 estimate for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996 by $0.03 a share. Rowan is expected to report results January 15.
-- Rowan provides offshore drilling and aviation services.
-- Its shares closed up 1-1/2 Thursday at 25-7/8.
